description: Laser SDK: agent memory, durable workflows, sessions and messaging on Apache Iggy, with matching Rust, Python and TypeScript clients.
rules: Never print or log the connection string or its password. Read it from LASER_CONNECTION_STRING inside the program.

Connect with a connection string from the LASER_CONNECTION_STRING environment variable through connect_env() in Python, connectEnv() in TypeScript or connect_env() in Rust. A LaserData API key is not a connection string.
Python installs with pip install laser-sdk and imports laser_sdk. TypeScript installs @laserdata/laser-sdk. Rust adds laser-sdk.
Use the SDK's own workflow, memory and session APIs for durable results. A local list, dict or plain function is not durable.
A LaserData Cloud deployment admits a Laser SDK connection only from an address its access rules allow over TCP.
